notes.title: Updates: Demo, Livestream, and the Amazing Avatar Affle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721820/4ea82647701cb96701fab39f9d72aa502e843510.png[/img]

Hello Peggy's Farm Fans!

Just a quick reminder that our final stream for NextFest is starting [b]now[/b]!

Also:
[list]
[*]We've updated our demo with some new bug fixes!
[*]You can still join our discord to enter the Amazing Avatar Affle!
[/list]
What's that, you ask?

Well, do you love the art for Peggy's Farm? So do we! And in the spirit of sharing the love (did we mention there's a FREE DEMO on Steam??), we're holding an Amazing Avatar Affle!! -- er... RAFFLE!

One lucky winner will have their face made into a custom avatar in the style of Peggy's Farm, with art done by the one and only Juju!!

Entering is easy:
[olist]
[*] Join our discord server (https://discord.gg/qHseqBM8Su)
[*] React to the announcement post about the Affle!
[/olist]

If you want to DOUBLE your chances to win, just wishlist Peggy's Farm right here on Steam - but you were already going to do that anyway, right?

You have until 11:59PM PST on Friday, February 16th to enter!

See you over at the stream!
